resources.string: Songs saved for offline are kept on the phone and play without the server. They are not counted in the music cache\'s size, and are saved on Wi-Fi only when that switch is on
Every page shows only the songs saved for offline: artists, albums, playlists, search and Home are made from them, and nothing waits for the server
